The '''Holy Places''' were sacred regions on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. By the time of [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask's]] visit to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in an autumn, [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] quakes rocked the Holy Places, as well as the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]], [[Varykino/Legends|Varykino]] and even the [[Ocean/Legends|undersea]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]].<ref name="SWDP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>
